diagnosis.hypothesis: Diagnosis: web1 (10.10.40.10, dmz_vlan) had no default route — its route table showed only the connected 10.10.40.0/24 and 172.20.0.0/24 routes, and every off-subnet ping from web1 failed with 'Network unreachable' (PB-14). The fabric (leaf1/leaf2 statics via the same next-hop group) and leaf2's interfaces/routing were all verified healthy, with no ACLs dropping traffic. Fix: added 'ip route add default via 10.10.40.1 dev eth1' on web1 only. Validation: all 10 lab_connectivity pairs now pass with 0% packet loss, including user1↔web1, guest1→web1, external1↔web1; previously healthy paths (user1↔app1, finance1↔app1) remain intact.
diagnosis.reference: On web1, the default route (0.0.0.0/0) was removed, so it has no route to other networks.

commands: ip route add default via 10.10.40.1 dev eth1
changes.reason: web1 route table shows only the connected 10.10.40.0/24 and 172.20.0.0/24 routes, no default route; web1 pings fail with 'Network unreachable' for all off-subnet destinations, matching PB-14 symptom of a host missing its default route. Its gateway 10.10.40.1 on leaf2 is up and present.
rollback_commands: ip route del default via 10.10.40.1 dev eth1

action.command: ip route add default via 10.10.40.1 dev eth1

Its gateway 10.10.40.1 on leaf2 is up and present.
